description: This file defines the AttachmentRepository class, which manages database operations related to attachments, including insert, find, delete, and update functions.

classes.name: AttachmentRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling database operations related to attachments.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new attachment record into the database.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment by its ID.

methods.name: findByParentId
methods.description: Finds attachments associated with a specific parent type and ID, optionally filtered by MIME type.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes an attachment by its ID.

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description: Returns total count and size of attachments.

methods.name: getFileNameById
methods.description: Retrieves the filename of an attachment by its ID.
